COMMERCE & MATERIALS

Mineral buying & trading.

A considered approach to sourcing enquiries, material specifications, counterparty information and commercial documentation.

MATERIAL & MARKET

From a mineral description to the right commercial conversation.

Whether you are looking to offer minerals for sale or explore a purchase, reliable material information is where the discussion starts.

Know the mineral type, available quantity, grade or assay data, location, ownership documentation and proposed transaction conditions. Trade requirements vary by material and jurisdiction.

BEFORE THE NEGOTIATION

The value of verified information.

Sampling context, assay information, proof of ownership, licences and lawful trade requirements can shape a commercial decision long before settlement or delivery.

A mineral buying or trading enquiry does not itself establish a price, confirm acceptance of material or enter a binding contract.
